title: A topology-based framework for robust cancer-associated gene signature identification from scRNA-seq data.
snippet: Cancer transcriptomics faces a fundamental challenge: conventional gene selection methods capture statistical variance but fail to decode the intrinsic geometric architecture of high-dimensional single-cell RNA sequencing data, leaving critical cancer-specific signals obscured by noise and biological heterogeneity. title: Chemical induction enhances patient-derived organoid fidelity to primary colorectal cancer at the single-cell level: A re-analysis of public scRNA-seq dataset GSE261012.
snippet: Patient-derived organoids (PDOs) are widely used preclinical models for colorectal cancer (CRC). title: Primary pulmonary presentation extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, small cell variant, illustrating the value of flow EBER in situ hybridisation assay.
snippet: A 57-year-old male from Guinea presented with 6 months of progressive shortness of breath, productive cough, and occasional night sweats.
